inputs.text: Job Sikhala, the former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader, is demanding the outright rejection of the proposed constitutional amendments reportedly intended to extend President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term until 2030. He took this stand at a press conference, denouncing the Constitutional Amendment Bill 3 as an unacceptable move by those in power. This is nothing less than a structural ploy by the elites to lock in their power and prevent any advancement toward equality. Such actions will only intensify the historical inequalities that have oppressed working people and vulnerable groups for years. We need to reject this without hesitation and fight for institutional reforms centered on social justice, labor rights, and the protection of the marginalized, rather than safeguarding the power of the elite.
